pixel_oracle.pixel_value_rule: All sampled components are exact endpoint0/1 and convert back to exact0/255; no empirical tolerance.
pixel_oracle.scope: Fixed source expectations only. Does not qualify arbitrary textures/filtering/resources, lower-edge clamp, GL/Metal/API or actual GPU pixels.

scope: Three original texture native source captures, no GPU sampler execution. Source endpoint texels and rational coordinate selection fixed before a physical run; exact prior observed pixels retained. Seqno seeds are emitter inputs, not packet patches.
